quotes.text: `ai-task-tray.js` stores dismissed keys in `${storageKey}:dismissed`. When a non-cancelled task reopens through `registerAiTaskDialog().update()`, delete `${kind}:${session.id}` and `persistDismissed()` before `trackAiTask()`. Minimize preserves session/tray entry; close/escape cancels and dismisses. [Task 12]
